['S\u00fcdFactoring GmbH '].company_description: SüdFactoring GmbH is a company that offers products related to commercial and industrial energy systems, including energy storage system offerings. It is also involved in the development and supply of high pressure alkaline electrolyzers, with a new 500 MW manufacturing capacity in Texas.

['maxingvest AG '].company_description: maxingvest AG is the holding company for Tchibo and Beiersdorf. It holds a 100% stake in Tchibo GmbH and controls more than 50% of the voting rights of Beiersdorf AG. The company specializes in the development, production, and marketing of cosmetic products.
